newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers stable, traders focus on cargo.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers stable, traders focus on cargo.

text.p: Singapore bunker quotes were stable on Monday amid uncertainties with traders' eyes fixed on the cargo market, looking for near term price direction brokers said.
It is uncertain where prices were headed, we are looking to the cargo market for price direction, a broker said.
Bunker 180-cst and 380-cst prices were quoted at around $119 and $125 respectively.
MDO and gas oil prices were steady at $238-$242 and $248-$255 per tonne respectively.
